newsitem.title: USA: CFTC chair concerned about some U.S. legal reforms.
newsitem.headline: CFTC chair concerned about some U.S. legal reforms.

text.p: The new chairperson of the Commodity Futures Commission said she has significant concerns about some portions of a Congressional proposal to amend U.S. commodities law.
Senators Richard Lugar and Patrick Leahy introduced a bill earlier this month that would make a dozen changes in the Commodity Exchange Act, the primary U.S. law governing futures trading.
"We are examining the provisions," Brooksley Born said in an interview with Reuters. "There are some that cause me some significant concern and others that don't."
